name: Crimthann of Tara

attributes.attribute: queen charmed by Crimthann of Tara
ended prematurely because Crimthann refused to travel on Sunday

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Crimthann of Tara was raised as the ward of king Diarmait. Queen Becfhola took notice of his good looks. She offered a meeting on a Sunday, yet Crimthann refused to travel on that day. His unwillingness to move then cut their affair short.

okr.objective: Crimthann of Tara was a king whose affair with queen Becfhola ended over Sunday travel.
key_results: He was the fosterling of king Diarmait.
Queen Becfhola gave his charms attention.
She offered a rendezvous on Sunday, and he refused to travel that day.
His refusal ended their affair prematurely.
okr.evidence: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
